name: compiler-explorer
description: Compiler Explorer (aka godbolt.org) is the canonical "what does my code compile to" tool. This MCP exposes the same backend Claude needs to compile and optionally execute source in 80+ languages across 2000+ compilers, link curated libraries, look up assembly instruction documentation, and round-trip godbolt.org/z/... short URLs to share sessions with humans. No auth required - it's the same public service the website runs on. Use it to verify what a snippet does, pick a compiler for a target architecture, or explain why one idiom compiles better than another.

tool.name: list_compilers
tool.description: List available compilers, optionally filtered by language

lean.description: Force id+name only, regardless of count. Useful to browse the catalog before drilling in.

match.description: Case-insensitive AND-of-tokens filter on id and name. Punctuation splits tokens; numeric tokens match whole-word ("gcc 14.1" matches "14.1.0" not "14.10"); alphanumeric tokens substring-match ("g14" matches "g142"). Literal text only — for "newest version" use `latestPerMajor`; for "newest X on arch Y" prefer `instructionSet` + `latestPerMajor`.

maxResults.description: Cap full-detail entries (default 25). Beyond the cap, degrades to lean (id+name only) with a refinement hint.

instructionSet.description: Target architecture filter. Combine with `latestPerMajor: true` for "newest X for arch Y" (e.g. `{language:"c++", instructionSet:"amd64", latestPerMajor:true}`).

latestPerMajor.description: "Newest X" filter. By release track (stable/nightly/prerelease/experimental): newest stable per (language, instructionSet, semver major); all nightly + prerelease; experimental skipped unless `includeExperimental: true`.

includeExperimental.description: With `latestPerMajor: true`, also include experimental compilers (c++ proposal forks, llvm-mos platform variants). Off by default — bloats "newest X" answers.

_published_faq.name: How do I add compiler-explorer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add compiler-explorer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://compiler-explorer.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is compiler-explorer MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, compiler-explorer scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is compiler-explorer's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, compiler-explorer scores 76/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 7 of 7 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the compiler-explorer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: compiler-explorer provides these MCP tools: list_compilers, list_languages, list_libraries, lookup_asm_instruction, generate_short_url, get_shortlink_info, and compile.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to compiler-explorer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to compiler-explorer in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
compiler-explorer does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can compiler-explorer improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: lookup_asm_instruction is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 72/100. No output schema is declared. Add one for structured results so clients can interpret returned fields. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
compiler-explorer is developed by Compiler Explorer LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
